Messages.Author: gotcha
Messages.Body:
60 card deck including fast reaction would be a though job for me.
- Since AUS is your main skill I'd say you have not too many options for combat: dodge - ), psychic assault (but no Black hands and maneuvers go well with this card - maybe spirit's touch - to have both intercept and combat) and you have (concealed weapon +) .44 which is probably most common for this kind of deck
- You need some poolgain / bloath so might use a powerbase/ blood doll / minion tap etc
- Intercept you have plenty of in those sets (enhanced senses, spirit's touch, ....)
- Some wake or forced awakening
- Something to oust .... smiling jack might be an option here

Maybe try to make a list with cards you have and want to include in the deck and post it ... it might be easier to comment on certain cards or amounts for people then just post a decklist.

GL

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
If you're going to block, use Forced Awakening over Wake with Evening's Freshness.
If you're rich ang going to block, use Eyes of Argus.

But always use On the Qui Vive.
Drop Giant's Blood, Information Highway (Powerbase Montreal is more fun). Society of Leopold is cool, but this is a slot. Use Pentex instead.

Precognition allows you to prevent that 1 agg (Claws, Ivory Bow, etc).

Recommended weapons: Ivory Bow (1), Sniper Rifle (1), .44 Magnum (2-3).
Also, you can use things such as Ossian or Young Bloods. Or Gregory Winter.

Messages.Author: alek
Messages.Body: Both hidden lurker and fast reaction are considered weak cards by majority of the players and there are good reasons for it. I wouldn't put any of them in the deck. For a AUS deck there is surprisingly small number of intercept cards in your deck. Check TWDA. Weenie AUS concept is one of the most popular and successfull on tournaments so there is plenty of very good and proven builds out there.

Messages.Author: dabbler
Messages.Body: What is TWDA? How many intercepts would be reasonable? What types? *Taking out fast reactions, and replacing with intercept enhanced senses, and Precognition. * What makes Fast reaction, and Hidden lurker weak cards?

Messages.Author: gotcha
Messages.Body:
Tournament winning deck archive (the link is on the left side:events : tournament winning decks)
I think both fast reaction and hidden lurker are very powerful but they are hard to play: if you do not have enough intercept you won't be blocking and they will just jam your hand; you need enough untapped minions to play them and you prefer something good in combat like ivory bow, which makes them being stuck in your hand most of the time while you could use other cards like more wake / intercept / maneuver / ....

Messages.Author: dabbler
Messages.Body: I never hesitate to discard a hidden lurker, especially if one turns up before I get at least three OB vamps out. I always figure that out of five I might only use three. Which is why I try to include an Elder Library, and The Barrens in a hidden lurker flavored deck. I find Fast Reactions harder to pull off then HL though. So I seldom stock too many.
